market_definition: The UV-curable adhesives market comprises adhesives that polymerise within seconds under ultraviolet or visible light via acrylate or cationic epoxy chemistry. It measures sales of finished single-cure photo-initiated adhesives. BY CHEMISTRY: Acrylate / Methacrylate, Cationic Epoxy, Thiol-Ene & Other. BY LIGHT SOURCE: Mercury Arc Lamp, UV LED, Visible Light. BY VISCOSITY: Low, Medium, High / Gel. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Electronics & Displays, Medical Devices, Glass & Optical Bonding, Automotive, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Dual-cure adhesives; optically clear adhesives sold as films or liquid OCA; UV-curable coatings and inks; electron-beam cure systems. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
